fields.name: customs_form_number
fields.description: Identifier for the customs form (e.g., CN22, CN23, or commercial invoice ref).

fields.name: destination_country
fields.description: Country to which the shipment is being exported.

fields.name: description_of_contents
fields.description: Details of items inside the package.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Total count of items, if applicable.

fields.name: unit_value
fields.description: Declared value per unit of the product.

fields.name: total_value
fields.description: Sum of declared values for all items.

fields.name: weight
fields.description: Gross weight of the package or items.

fields.name: hs_tariff_code
fields.description: Harmonized System code for commodity classification.

fields.name: signature_date
fields.description: Signature and date from shipper/exporter to certify correctness.

document.document_description: Customs forms (e.g., CN22, commercial invoices for customs) may be a single-page document detailing declared goods, value, and origin. They are used by customs authorities to assess import duties, confirm import/export compliance, and ensure accurate cargo descriptions.
